family_constraints.frame: 12 separate 1x1 10-Series aluminum-extrusion members: eight 18-inch posts/depth rails and four 22-inch width rails
family_constraints.visual_language: silver aluminum extrusion, charcoal/black flat panels, black controls and latches, restrained functional accent colors
family_constraints.release_boundary: prototype product-concept CAD only; dynamic loads, vehicle anchoring, tolerances, wiring, plumbing, heat, and physical tests remain human engineering gates

modules.name: Cook Station
modules.signature: two exposed burners, controls, three-sided wind guard, pull-out stove tray, upper prep surface, cookware drawer
modules.deployment: stove tray slides toward user; cooking occurs outdoors with propane stored separately
modules.manufacturing_focus: flat work surfaces, shared slides/latches, heat-clearance test

modules.name: Dry Pantry
modules.signature: three graduated drawers, open upper divided tray, visible pulls and compression latches
modules.deployment: drawers open toward user and must remain positively latched in transit
modules.manufacturing_focus: shared slides/latches and flat routed drawer panels

modules.name: Fridge Freezer
modules.signature: recognizable top-opening compact fridge, lid, carry handle, controls, vents, slide tray, restraint strap
modules.deployment: low tray slides out far enough for full lid swing and compressor ventilation
modules.manufacturing_focus: sold-out primary product, alternate procurement, slide/lock integration, fused 12V routing

modules.name: Sink Wash
modules.signature: open stainless basin, raised faucet, drain, visible pump and grey-water tank, blue hose route
modules.deployment: faucet and basin remain accessible while pump, drain and grey container can be serviced
modules.manufacturing_focus: released sink cutout, flat support panel, flexible plumbing, leak tray and test

modules.name: Fresh Water
modules.signature: ribbed seven-gallon container, molded handle, fill cap, spigot, low restraint straps, service pump and hose
modules.deployment: container can be filled or removed and pump/spigot are accessible without releasing the primary restraint
modules.manufacturing_focus: 58-pound full-water load, low center of gravity, food-safe plumbing and spill tray

modules.name: Recovery Utility
modules.signature: sealed tool case/drawer, adjustable shelf, MOLLE panel and slots, recovery rope and soft shackles
modules.deployment: heavy gear stays low; drawer, shelf and MOLLE tools remain independently accessible
modules.manufacturing_focus: rugged OTS case, shared slides/latches, payload dividers and retention

modules.name: Power Hub
modules.signature: recognizable power-station enclosure, display, AC/DC/USB ports, vents, cable drawer and bulkhead
modules.deployment: display, charging ports and ventilation remain open while the station is restrained
modules.manufacturing_focus: OTS power station, vented flat shelf, cable grommets, fuse/wiring and thermal test

modules.name: Hot Water Shower
modules.signature: portable heater body, display, knob, vents, shower head, hose route, quick connects and wet-storage tray
modules.deployment: heater is transported only in the module and operated outside with propane separate
modules.manufacturing_focus: complete OTS kit, ventilated/drainable storage, connector access and safety label

modules.name: Field Office Camera
modules.signature: rugged equipment case, latches/ribs, deployed worktop, visible laptop and keyboard, accessory drawer
modules.deployment: case and drawer open independently and worktop has positive support
modules.manufacturing_focus: OTS case/dividers, shared slides/latches and flat supported worktop

modules.name: Camp Furniture Soft Goods
modules.signature: recognizable folded chairs/table, rolled soft goods, contrasting compression straps, cargo net and anchors
modules.deployment: individual furniture bags can be removed without unloading the entire bay
modules.manufacturing_focus: fully OTS chair/table set and rated straps with simple flat dividers
